Hack the North

September 18-20, 2026 • In-person event

Official Member

Hacker and Volunteer applications are closed!
Sign up for emails about next year's event!

Sign Up
@DaepaloyWorks on YouTube
Welcome to Canada's biggest hackathon

This September, join 1,000+ hackers from around the world and build with people who think differently. Learn from world-class mentors, connect with the community, and turn ideas into something real. 13 years in, Hack the North continues to bring hands-on workshops, unforgettable experiences, and real connections with the companies shaping what's next in tech.

Not from Waterloo? We cover food, help with travel expenses, and provide lodging so you can focus on turning your dreams into reality.

You belong in tech

Breaking into tech isn't always straightforward. Hack the North is built to lower those barriers, bringing together attendees from around the world in a space where everyone can learn, build, and dream bigger!

Canada's biggest hackathon!
Join a global community

Step into a vibrant space of curious, creative students from around the world. Connect with mentors, sponsors, and industry leaders, explore new ideas, and build something you’re proud of, no matter your experience level.

Plant the seed of an idea

Start with a spark and watch it grow. We’ll support you with mentorship, workshops, and all the tools you need — so you can focus on building, experimenting, and bringing your ideas to life.

Make lasting memories

Take a break from hacking and enjoy fun activities planned just for you! Whether it’s spicy chip challenges or therapy dogs, there’s always a way to recharge and make lasting memories.

Dream big and build bigger

Every year, hackers bring bold ideas to life at Hack the North. Explore past projects and the stories behind them, and get inspired for what you'll build next.

S-KBD67

This project reimagines FPS gameplay by turning a Nerf blaster into a real-world game controller, where aiming, movement, reloading, and weapon switching are driven by physical motion and embedded inputs. Sensor-equipped hardware sends data wirelessly to a Python backend, which translates player actions into responsive in-game controls in real time.

View Project
Explore the Museum of Hack the North

Inside are projects built by hackers like you. From first sparks to finished creations, see how ideas grow and start imagining your own.

Explore the Exhibition

We're Annapurna Labs! We build Amazon's custom chips: Graviton (the processors running AWS), Trainium and Inferentia (the silicon behind AI training and inference). We design the hardware. We write the compilers. We make models run fast on silicon we built from scratch. We're basically like a chip startup that doesn't have to fundraise.. :) If you like building things at the lowest level, come find us. We're hiring interns and new grads and we move fast.

Careers Page →

Dominion Dynamics is building intelligent systems for extreme operations: integrated autonomy, sensing, communications, and command and control capabilities for defence, security, and critical infrastructure.

Backed by some of the world’s best investors, our team includes veterans of Anduril, Amazon, Tesla, and the Canadian Armed Forces, combining Silicon Valley speed with Waterloo-grade engineering and a deep national-security focus.

If you're driven by the opportunity to solve complex problems, build something real, and change the country, this is where you belong.

Federato is on a mission to help insurers deliver efficient, equitable, and affordable coverage in a rapidly changing world shaped by climate risk, cyber threats, and social inflation. As the only AI-native platform spanning the full policy lifecycle, Federato transforms how insurance work gets done by embedding better decision-making directly into underwriting workflows. Insurers can align portfolio goals, business strategies, rules, and risk appetite within a single system, enabling underwriters to identify and win the right opportunities faster. From submission intake to portfolio management, AI prioritizes high-appetite business, delivers real-time insights, streamlines workflows, and helps insurers achieve stronger, more profitable outcomes.

We’re focused on helping motivate and encourage the next generation of brilliant minds to grow their skills, make an impact, and Be What’s Next.

With Sentry's AI-powered debugging tool, Seer, you don't just see what broke, you get intelligent suggestions to fix it faster. From error monitoring and distributed tracing to session replay and log management, Sentry brings everything into one place so your team can ship with confidence.

Stop guessing. Start fixing. Try Sentry free at sentry.io.

The next era of software isn’t happening in giant server farms - it’s happening on-device and peer-to-peer. We’re hiring the hackers who want to build decentralized networks, local AI, and truly sovereign tech.

Skip the standard internship grind. Come build the future of the internet with us.

Frequently asked questions
What is Hack the North?

Hack the North is Canada's biggest hackathon, where 1,000+ students of different skill levels come together from around the world to experiment and create unique software or hardware projects from scratch. We empower and enable teams to make something great in only 36 hours by providing an abundance of resources like workshops, mentors, sponsors, and hardware.

Who can participate?

Students of any education level from anywhere in the world are eligible to apply for Hack the North! All attendees must be 13 years or older to participate.

How much does it cost to attend Hack the North?

Admission to Hack the North is completely free! We will also provide food and accommodation for the entire event, as well as all the resources and mentorship our hackers need to build something incredible.

What if I’ve never been to a hackathon before?

Hack the North welcomes students of all skill levels. Many students attend Hack the North as their first hackathon, and they always have a blast! We’ll provide tech resources (including hardware), mentors, and workshops to help you with your project; hackathons can be a great place to learn new skills in a short amount of time. Just be eager to learn, and excited to meet lots of awesome people.

Will Hack the North 2026 happen in person or virtually?

Hack the North 2026 will be an in-person hackathon, hosted at the University of Waterloo in Ontario, Canada. Stay tuned to hear the latest updates by following our social media channels (@hackthenorth), and signing up for our mailing list!

When do hacker applications open?

We will be opening hacker applications in the coming weeks. Sign up for our mailing list, and follow our social media channels to be the first to hear the exciting news!

How many people can be on a team?

Hackers may form teams of up to 4 people. There are no restrictions for who they can be, so you can team up with hackers from any school, country, or experience level. Teams can be formed before or during the event at hackers’ own discretion.

What kind of workshops, talks, and activities will there be?

Previously, we’ve held workshops and talks for a range of skill levels from beginner to advanced like A Dreamer’s Guide to AR/VR Development and Fantastic Agents and How to Build Them. Other workshops also explore various programming tools such as APIs, databases, and platforms. Activities like VR demos, meetups, and even karaoke happen throughout the weekend. Whether it’s for relaxation or health, novelty or competition, our team has something exciting prepared for you to enjoy!

What if I want to join virtually?

Hack the North aims to provide participants with the best experience possible, and we strongly feel that an in-person event is the best way to empower our hackers to dream big and build. We will not be offering a virtual attendance option this year.

What if I need to travel internationally to attend Hack the North?

Please note that visitor visa wait times may be as long as several months, depending on the country of departure. We recommend you apply for your visa, if required, immediately after receiving your acceptance to Hack the North. More information can be found on our Travel Guidelines page.

I’m not currently enrolled as a student, can I still attend Hack the North?

Hack the North is geared towards students who are interested in tech, but we also want to open the doors for anyone who wants to learn. If your situation falls within this category, please reach out to us at hello@hackthenorth.com and we can chat more regarding certain exemptions!

Hey Hackers!

Hack the North is put on by builders for builders, and this year we're bringing you all together for our most ambitious event yet.

You won't want to miss this.

We're emphasizing interactivity throughout the event and hiding surprises everywhere: on this wonderful website, in some mind-blowing hardware, and weaving you into the story itself!

And we're doing all this to inspire you to be as creative as possible, to dream big and build amazing things now and into the future, because we know you're capable of greatness.

So we hope you're as hyped as we are, and we can't wait to see you in September! In the meantime, we'll get back to organizing.

— Team Hack the North 💚

Frequently asked questions

What is Hack the North?

Hack the North is Canada's biggest hackathon, where 1,000+ students of different skill levels come together from around the world to experiment and create unique software or hardware projects from scratch. We empower and enable teams to make something great in only 36 hours by providing an abundance of resources like workshops, mentors, sponsors, and hardware.

Who can participate?

Students of any education level from anywhere in the world are eligible to apply for Hack the North! All attendees must be 13 years or older to participate.

How much does it cost to attend Hack the North?

Admission to Hack the North is completely free! We will also provide food and accommodation for the entire event, as well as all the resources and mentorship our hackers need to build something incredible.

What if I’ve never been to a hackathon before?

Hack the North welcomes students of all skill levels. Many students attend Hack the North as their first hackathon, and they always have a blast! We’ll provide tech resources (including hardware), mentors, and workshops to help you with your project; hackathons can be a great place to learn new skills in a short amount of time. Just be eager to learn, and excited to meet lots of awesome people.

Will Hack the North 2026 happen in person or virtually?

Hack the North 2026 will be an in-person hackathon, hosted at the University of Waterloo in Ontario, Canada. Stay tuned to hear the latest updates by following our social media channels (@hackthenorth), and signing up for our mailing list!

When do hacker applications open?

We will be opening hacker applications in the coming weeks. Sign up for our mailing list, and follow our social media channels to be the first to hear the exciting news!

How many people can be on a team?

Hackers may form teams of up to 4 people. There are no restrictions for who they can be, so you can team up with hackers from any school, country, or experience level. Teams can be formed before or during the event at hackers’ own discretion.

What kind of workshops, talks, and activities will there be?

Previously, we’ve held workshops and talks for a range of skill levels from beginner to advanced like A Dreamer’s Guide to AR/VR Development and Fantastic Agents and How to Build Them. Other workshops also explore various programming tools such as APIs, databases, and platforms. Activities like VR demos, meetups, and even karaoke happen throughout the weekend. Whether it’s for relaxation or health, novelty or competition, our team has something exciting prepared for you to enjoy!

What if I want to join virtually?

Hack the North aims to provide participants with the best experience possible, and we strongly feel that an in-person event is the best way to empower our hackers to dream big and build. We will not be offering a virtual attendance option this year.

What if I need to travel internationally to attend Hack the North?

Please note that visitor visa wait times may be as long as several months, depending on the country of departure. We recommend you apply for your visa, if required, immediately after receiving your acceptance to Hack the North. More information can be found on our Travel Guidelines page.

I’m not currently enrolled as a student, can I still attend Hack the North?

Hack the North is geared towards students who are interested in tech, but we also want to open the doors for anyone who wants to learn. If your situation falls within this category, please reach out to us at hello@hackthenorth.com and we can chat more regarding certain exemptions!

Hey Hackers!

Hack the North is put on by builders for builders, and this year we're bringing you all together for our most ambitious event yet.

You won't want to miss this.

We're emphasizing interactivity throughout the event and hiding surprises everywhere: on this wonderful website, in some mind-blowing hardware, and weaving you into the story itself!

And we're doing all this to inspire you to be as creative as possible, to dream big and build amazing things now and into the future, because we know you're capable of greatness.

So we hope you're as hyped as we are, and we can't wait to see you in September! In the meantime, we'll get back to organizing.

— Team Hack the North 💚
